info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Portfolio Management API
info.description: The Product Portfolio Management API allows businesses to efficiently update aspects of their product portfolio, facilitating real-time adjustments based on market analysis. This API provides endpoints to modify product details, aligning offerings with strategic business objectives. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and business analysts who require agile tools for maintaining competitive product lines. By integrating this API into their workflows, organizations can enhance their decision-making processes and optimize their product strategies.
